scope: Existing three public papers; development questions only. No production enablement, new weights, paid model or held-out scoring.
previous_policy: At most one prior prose block from the same document, run and physical page, within 0.20 normalized page-height and with at least 0.5 horizontal overlap relative to the smaller width; at least eight indexed words. No cross-page or foreign-column inference.
title_policy: Only existing first-page native layout title candidates that resolve to unique exact source substrings. Candidate labels do not establish verified publication metadata.
heading_policy: Nearest preceding source-bound parsed heading and at most its two ancestors; separate numbered parts keep their own literal anchors.
budget_policy: Clip context to literal source character spans. Preserve complete target span. If final passage-prefixed token count exceeds 512, remove previous first, then oldest heading components, then title components. Never silently truncate the encoded input.
provenance: Every source part includes document/run/block/physical page/full block bbox/exact character range/text hash. New input/cache keys bind policy, model fingerprint, all ordered parts and complete input hash. Never reuse the old raw block cache.
ranking: Maximum chunk cosine per target block. Evaluate existing quality and BM25/RRF separately, using identical frozen questions and canonical target identities. Additional context is not an extra recalled target.
limits: Agent-authored multilingual fixture; no independent human/native-language quality claim
No general context accuracy, irrelevant-query threshold, deduplication or end-to-end S3 acceptance implied
